next.title: What happens next
next.step1: Your message is encrypted on this device and sent to verified mutual aid groups serving the area you chose.
next.step2: You get a safe word on the next screen. Write it down - a group will repeat it back to you so you know the contact is genuine.
next.step3: A group contacts you the way you asked. If nobody has been in touch after a few days, you can send another request.
